A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before your big day.

How do I check availability?

Send your event date, occasion and location. The studio will confirm availability directly.

Where can I find prices and packages?

Ask the studio for a personalised quote and confirm what is included in your chosen service.

Can I request travel to my venue?

Include your city and venue so the studio can confirm travel availability and any charges.

How are my favourites saved?

Only your selected look IDs are saved in this browser. Your name and event details are not stored by this website. When you continue, those details are included in your WhatsApp message.
